prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas. Injury: knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1206; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was backing out of a parking spot at a grocery store in Conroe, Texas, moving slowly with my mirrors checked, when the other vehicle came around the end of the row and struck the rear passenger side of my car. The impact was low speed, but I felt a sharp pain in my right knee when my foot pressed the brake pedal and my body jolted forward against the seatbelt. I got out, exchanged information with the other driver, and asked for a police report, which was filed at the scene. I have described the events the same way to the adjuster, to the medical staff, and to the store's manager, and I have nothing to add or change. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating my own vehicle with the owner's permission. I am submitting this claim for the medical costs and the vehicle repairs.
